description: This file contains a custom speed test module for the Odoo (OpenERP) platform, including classes for measuring database query performance and generating HTML reports.

classes.name: CounterCursor
classes.description: A wrapper around a database cursor that counts the number of SELECT queries executed.

classes.name: quality_test
classes.description: A class that performs a speed test on Odoo modules by measuring database query efficiency and generating HTML reports.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Constructor for CounterCursor and quality_test classes.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the query count in CounterCursor.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes a SQL query and increments count if it is a SELECT statement.

methods.name: __getattr__
methods.description: Delegates attribute access to the underlying cursor.

methods.name: run_test
methods.description: Performs the speed test on a specified module, measuring query complexity and generating results.

methods.name: get_result
methods.description: Formats the speed test results into a table.

methods.name: get_result_details
methods.description: Generates detailed HTML report of the speed test results.
